quotations.old_english: Sibæðelingas (Beowulf and Wiglaf; a few lines before the former is spoken of as the mǽg of the latter).

source_text: sib-æðeling, es; m. A prince and kinsman:-- Sibæðelingas (Beowulf and Wiglaf; a few lines before the former is spoken of as the mǽg of the latter). Beo. Th. 5409; B. 2708.
